question.q: The engine was making a strange noise, so I took the car to a ________.
question.justification: الميكانيكي (mechanic) هو من يصلح السيارات. المعلم (teacher) يعلم، والطبيب (doctor) يعالج الناس، والمزارع (farmer) يزرع الأرض.
question.context_sentence: The engine was making a strange noise, so I took the car to a ________.

question.q: She spent years at medical school to become a qualified ________.
question.justification: مريم تتدرب لتصبح طبيبة (doctor). النادل (waiter) يقدم الطعام، والسكرتير (secretary) ينظم المواعيد، وأمين المكتبة (librarian) يعمل مع الكتب.
question.context_sentence: She spent years at medical school to become a qualified ________.

question.q: The ________ took the patient's temperature and blood pressure.
question.justification: الممرض (nurse) يساعد الطبيب في رعاية المرضى. الميكانيكي (mechanic) يصلح الآلات، والمزارع (farmer) في الحقول، والسائق (driver) يقود المركبات.
question.context_sentence: The ________ took the patient's temperature and blood pressure.

question.q: The ________ produces thousands of cars every year.
question.justification: التلفزيونات تُصنع في المصنع (factory). المستشفى (hospital) يعالج المرضى، والبنك (bank) للأموال، والمكتب (office) للأعمال الإدارية.
question.context_sentence: The ________ produces thousands of cars every year.

question.q: The ________ wakes up early every morning to tend the crops.
question.justification: المزارعون (farmers) يعتنون بالأرض ويزرعونها. الأطباء (doctors) يعالجون الناس، والمهندسون (engineers) يصممون ويبنون، والحلاقون (barbers) يقصون الشعر.
question.context_sentence: The ________ wakes up early every morning to tend the crops.

question.q: A good ________ can inspire students to love learning.
question.justification: تحتاج مهارات لتكون معلماً (teacher) جيداً. مراقب المرور (traffic warden) ينظم السير، والموظف (clerk) يعمل في مكتب، وأمين المكتبة (librarian) يدير الكتب.
question.context_sentence: A good ________ can inspire students to love learning.

question.q: The ________ arrested the suspect and read him his rights.
question.justification: ضابط الشرطة (police officer) يتعامل مع المجرمين. الطبيب (doctor) يعالج المرضى، وأمين المكتبة (librarian) يعمل مع الكتب، والنادل (waiter) يقدم الطعام.
question.context_sentence: The ________ arrested the suspect and read him his rights.

question.q: The ________ brought the menus and took our drink orders.
question.justification: من يقدم الطعام هو النادل (waiter). الشرطة (police) تحفظ الأمن، وأمين المكتبة (librarian) يعمل مع الكتب، والحلاق (barber) يقص الشعر.
question.context_sentence: The ________ brought the menus and took our drink orders.

question.q: He visits the ________ once a month to get his hair cut and beard trimmed.
question.justification: للحصول على قصة شعر تذهب إلى الحلاق (barber). الشرطة (police) للأمن، وأمين المكتبة (librarian) للكتب، والنادل (waiter) للمطعم.
question.context_sentence: He visits the ________ once a month to get his hair cut and beard trimmed.

question.q: She went to the ________ to deposit her paycheck.
question.justification: يفتح الحساب في البنك (bank). المطعم (restaurant) للطعام، والمصنع (factory) للإنتاج، والمتجر (shop) للبيع.
question.context_sentence: She went to the ________ to deposit her paycheck.

question.q: They celebrated their anniversary at an Italian ________ downtown.
question.justification: تناولنا العشاء في مطعم (restaurant). البنك (bank) للمال، والصيدلية (pharmacy) للدواء، والمرأب (garage) للسيارات.
question.context_sentence: They celebrated their anniversary at an Italian ________ downtown.

question.q: The ________ helped me find the reference books I needed.
question.justification: أمين المكتبة (librarian) ينظم الكتب. الميكانيكي (mechanic) يصلح الآلات، والمزارع (farmer) يعمل في الأرض، والحلاق (barber) يقص الشعر.
question.context_sentence: The ________ helped me find the reference books I needed.

question.q: The ________ answers phone calls and manages the manager's schedule.
question.justification: السكرتير (secretary) هو من يحدد المواعيد. الميكانيكي (mechanic) يصلح الآلات، والمزارع (farmer) يزرع، والنادل (waiter) يقدم الطعام.
question.context_sentence: The ________ answers phone calls and manages the manager's schedule.

question.q: Safety is the number one ________ on any construction site.
question.justification: الزواج هو أولويته (priority) القصوى. الدخل (income) هو المال، والبيئة (environment) هي المحيط، والمشكلة (problem) أمر سلبي.
question.context_sentence: Safety is the number one ________ on any construction site.

question.q: She needs a steady ________ to pay the rent and other living expenses.
question.justification: الدخل المنتظم (income) يساعد في دفع الفواتير. المصروف (expense) ما ينفق، والقرض (loan) مال مستعار، والدين (debt) التزام مالي.
question.context_sentence: She needs a steady ________ to pay the rent and other living expenses.

question.q: China is the most ________ country in the world, with over 1.4 billion people.
question.justification: كاليفورنيا هي الولاية الأكثر اكتظاظاً بالسكان (populous). الفارغة (empty) والهادئة (quiet) والصغيرة (small) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: China is the most ________ country in the world, with over 1.4 billion people.

question.q: ________ remains a vital part of the economy, employing millions of people.
question.justification: الزراعة (agriculture) قطاع رئيسي في كاليفورنيا. التكنولوجيا (technology) والترفيه (entertainment) والسياحة (tourism) قطاعات أخرى مهمة أيضاً، لكن الزراعة هي المذكورة في النص.
question.context_sentence: ________ remains a vital part of the economy, employing millions of people.

question.q: The severe ________ caused the reservoirs to dry up and crops to fail.
question.justification: كاليفورنيا تعاني أحياناً من الجفاف (drought). الفيضان (flood) والمطر (rain) والثلج (snow) ظواهر مناخية أخرى.
question.context_sentence: The severe ________ caused the reservoirs to dry up and crops to fail.

question.q: The archaeologists discovered a rare ________ dating back to the Bronze Age.
question.justification: المتحف يعرض قطعاً أثرية (artifacts). الحيوانات (animals) والنباتات (plants) والآلات (machines) قد تكون في أماكن أخرى.
question.context_sentence: The archaeologists discovered a rare ________ dating back to the Bronze Age.

question.q: The ________ system brings water from the river to the fields through canals.
question.justification: المزارعون يستخدمون الري (irrigation) لسقاية المحاصيل. النوم (sleeping) والجري (running) والأكل (eating) لا علاقة لها بزراعة.
question.context_sentence: The ________ system brings water from the river to the fields through canals.

question.q: The ________ of oil prices makes it hard for businesses to plan ahead.
question.justification: التذبذب الاقتصادي (fluctuation) يؤثر على الوظائف. الاستقرار (stability) والمساواة (equality) واليقين (certainty) أمور إيجابية.
question.context_sentence: The ________ of oil prices makes it hard for businesses to plan ahead.

question.q: The ________ excavation uncovered the ruins of an ancient Roman city.
question.justification: المواقع الأثرية (archaeological) تجذب السياح. الحديثة (modern) والصناعية (industrial) والسكنية (residential) قد لا تكون بنفس الجاذبية.
question.context_sentence: The ________ excavation uncovered the ruins of an ancient Roman city.

question.q: The researchers recorded the ________ of dolphins to study their communication.
question.justification: الحيتان تصدر أصواتاً (vocalisations) معقدة. الصمت (silence) عكس ذلك، والإيماءات (gestures) والأضواء (lights) ليست وسائل تواصل الحيتان.
question.context_sentence: The researchers recorded the ________ of dolphins to study their communication.

question.q: A ________ of whales was spotted migrating south for the winter.
question.justification: مجموعة الحيتان العائلية تسمى (pod). 'school' للأسماك، 'flock' للطيور، 'herd' للأبقار.
question.context_sentence: A ________ of whales was spotted migrating south for the winter.

question.q: Building the Great Wall was a ________ achievement that took centuries to complete.
question.justification: الأهرامات هياكل ضخمة (monumental). الصغيرة (tiny) والحديثة (modern) والضعيفة (weak) لا تصفها.
question.context_sentence: Building the Great Wall was a ________ achievement that took centuries to complete.

question.q: They built a ________ to help move the heavy equipment up to the platform.
question.justification: العمال ربما استخدموا المنحدرات (ramps) لرفع الأحجار. العربات (carts) والحبال (ropes) والعجلات (wheels) أدوات أخرى محتملة لكن المنحدرات هي النظرية الأقوى.
question.context_sentence: They built a ________ to help move the heavy equipment up to the platform.

question.q: A ________ is too small to be seen without a microscope.
question.justification: الكائن الدقيق (microorganism) هو كائن حي صغير جداً. الفيل (elephant) والجبل (mountain) والنهر (river) أشياء كبيرة.
question.context_sentence: A ________ is too small to be seen without a microscope.

question.q: Doctors often recommend taking ________ supplements to support gut health.
question.justification: الزبادي يحتوي على البروبيوتك (probiotics) المفيدة للهضم. المضادات الحيوية (antibiotics) تقتل البكتيريا، والفيتامينات (vitamins) والمعادن (minerals) مغذيات أخرى.
question.context_sentence: Doctors often recommend taking ________ supplements to support gut health.

question.q: Childhood ________ is a growing health concern in many developed countries.
question.justification: الإفراط في المضادات الحيوية قد يسبب السمنة (obesity). النحافة (thinness) والطول (height) والنظر (vision) ليست آثاراً مرتبطة.
question.context_sentence: Childhood ________ is a growing health concern in many developed countries.

question.q: A strong ________ system helps fight off infections and diseases.
question.justification: بكتيريا الأمعاء تساعد في تدريب الجهاز المناعي (immune system). الهضمي (digestive) للطعام، والعصبي (nervous) للإشارات، والتنفسي (respiratory) للتنفس.
question.context_sentence: A strong ________ system helps fight off infections and diseases.

question.q: The doctor advised him to make some ________ changes to lower his cholesterol.
question.justification: السجلات الغذائية (dietary) تكشف عادات الأكل القديمة. الطبية (medical) للأمراض، والقانونية (legal) للقوانين، والموسيقية (musical) للفن.
question.context_sentence: The doctor advised him to make some ________ changes to lower his cholesterol.

question.q: Stories passed from grandparents to grandchildren are a form of ________.
question.justification: تطور أغاني الحيتان يُظهر انتقالاً ثقافياً (cultural transmission). الطفرة الجينية (genetic mutation) والتلوث (pollution) والصيد (hunting) لا تفسر تطور الأغاني.
question.context_sentence: Stories passed from grandparents to grandchildren are a form of ________.

question.q: NASA is developing new rockets for future ________ missions to Mars.
question.justification: ستارشيب تهدف للسفر بين الكواكب (interplanetary). المحلي (domestic) وداخل الأرض (underground) والبحري (submarine) ليست أهدافها.
question.context_sentence: NASA is developing new rockets for future ________ missions to Mars.

question.q: The ________ industry invests billions in developing new medicines.
question.justification: الإجراءات الصيدلانية (pharmaceutical) تحمي الرواد. الموسيقية (musical) والزراعية (agricultural) والمعمارية (architectural) لا علاقة لها بالحماية من الإشعاع.
question.context_sentence: The ________ industry invests billions in developing new medicines.

question.q: The old building's ________ was covered in beautiful marble carvings.
question.justification: مبنى الخزانة له واجهة (facade) متقنة. الحديقة (garden) والقبو (basement) والمطبخ (kitchen) ليست ما تشتهر به الخزانة.
question.context_sentence: The old building's ________ was covered in beautiful marble carvings.

question.q: The kingdom was ________ by its more powerful neighbor after a brief war.
question.justification: الرومان ضموا (annexed) مملكة الأنباط إلى إمبراطوريتهم. لم يتجاهلوها (ignored) ولم يدمروها بالكامل (destroyed) ولم يبنوها (built).
question.context_sentence: The kingdom was ________ by its more powerful neighbor after a brief war.

question.q: The ________ of data from several departments helped create a unified report.
question.justification: النوم يساعد في توطيد الذاكرة (consolidation). التدمير (destruction) والارتباك (confusion) والمحو (erasure) عكس ذلك.
question.context_sentence: The ________ of data from several departments helped create a unified report.

question.q: Sleep ________ can lead to serious health problems over time.
question.justification: الحرمان من النوم (deprivation) يضر الصحة. الزيادة (excess) والإضافة (addition) والمكمل (supplement) لا تعبر عن قلة النوم.
question.context_sentence: Sleep ________ can lead to serious health problems over time.

question.q: Puzzles and brain games can help improve ________ abilities.
question.justification: الوظيفة المعرفية (cognitive) تتراجع بدون نوم. الجسدية (physical) والعضلية (muscular) والهيكلية (skeletal) لا تتأثر بنفس الدرجة.
question.context_sentence: Puzzles and brain games can help improve ________ abilities.

question.q: The spacecraft is equipped with special ________ to protect the crew from solar radiation.
question.justification: التدريع (shielding) يحمي رواد الفضاء من الإشعاع. الطبخ (cooking) والتزيين (decorating) والإضاءة (lighting) لا تحمي من الإشعاع.
question.context_sentence: The spacecraft is equipped with special ________ to protect the crew from solar radiation.
